provenance.locator: Tabelle 2 "Rundherdmanagment Index CT" + S3 narrative section (April 2025 representation)

recommendation.rationale: S3 recommends a three-stage CT surveillance schedule (3, 6-12, and 18-24 months) for a solitary, solid, incidental pulmonary nodule in the 5mm-<8mm diameter (or 80mm3-<300mm3 volume) range, in a patient >=18 years old with no known malignancy history and not immunocompromised.
